Global middleware order from declared constraints: before=* is the
outer band, requires=/after= edges order within a band, unconstrained
globals keep (file, line) order, and a soft edge to an undeclared name
stays silent but visible in the placement label. Chain requires= is
satisfied by a global (guard requires the global session) or an
earlier chain member (audit requires guard).
-- go.mod --
module app

go 1.27
-- main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- alpha/mw.go --
package alpha

import "net/http"

//fabrik:http:middleware name=sessionauth global=true requires=session after=phantom
func SessionAuth(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }
-- beta/mw.go --
package beta

import "net/http"

//fabrik:http:middleware global=true
func Tail(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware
func BareNoop(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }
-- shared/mw.go --
package shared

import "net/http"

//fabrik:http:middleware name=session global=true
func Session(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }
-- zeta/mw.go --
package zeta

import "net/http"

//fabrik:http:middleware global=true before=*
func Logged(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware name=guard requires=session
func Guard(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware name=audit requires=guard
func Audit(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http GET / middleware=guard,audit
func Index(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"

	"app/alpha"
	"app/beta"
	"app/shared"
	"app/zeta"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		r := router.New()

		// Middleware
		// before=*
		r.Use(zeta.Logged)
		// unconstrained (file order)
		r.Use(beta.Tail)
		// before sessionauth
		r.Use(shared.Session)
		// after=phantom (inactive); requires=session
		r.Use(alpha.SessionAuth)

		// Register
		r.Method("GET", "/", zeta.Index, zeta.Guard, zeta.Audit)
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
